title: Landers
description: Lightweight vanilla+ pack made with private SMP servers in mind.
body:
- **Lander's goal is to have a lightweight mostly vanilla experience but with quality of life improvements using AppleSkin, Gravestones, Distant Horizons, Xaero's Minimap and World Map, Fresh Animations, Mouse Tweaks, and more while also maintaining compatibility with the latest version of Minecraft.**

- **Landers is made for multiplayer but should work in singleplayer as well. Every version of the modpack will have a list of recommended mods to use on dedicated servers in the changelogs as well as the recommended Minecraft & Fabric versions for servers.**

- For server owners, drop the "config" folder in the main server folder (same folder that has server.jar in it), and drop the "serverconfig" folder in the world folder once your world has been generated. [Link](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GUsXawXz9hjwWkD3vVuAHVF6hVABt0cy?usp=sharing) to google drive for the "config" & "serverconfig" folders.


   _This Modpack was originally made for players to keep up to date with the private Landers server._
